@app_name.description: The name of the app, wherever it names itself.

@liveedit_copy.description: The button of a code block that copies its text.

@liveedit_copied.description: What the copy button of a code block says just after copying.

@shell_open_hint.description: What the box in the title bar says it does.

@shell_save_as.description: Saves the document to a file the user picks.

@shell_close.description: Closes a tab or the window.

@shell_toggle_theme.description: The button that flips the theme.

@shell_view_live.description: The view that renders Markdown as you type.

@shell_view_source.description: The view of the plain Markdown text.

@shell_open_documents.description: The heading of the sidebar list.

@shell_saved.description: The status of a document with nothing to save.

@shell_saving.description: The status while writing to disk.

@shell_unsaved.description: The status of a document with changes not on disk.

@shell_conflict.description: The file changed on disk, so saving stopped.

@shell_save_failed.description: The status after a failed save.

shell_welcome: Open a file and start writing

@shell_welcome.description: The line under the name on the welcome page.

shell_too_large: This file is over 5 MB and cannot be opened yet

@shell_too_large.description: A notice when a file is too large.

@shell_not_found.description: A notice when a file is gone.

@shell_failed.description: A notice for any other failure.

@shell_confirm_title.description: Asked when closing a document with unsaved changes.

@shell_markdown_files.description: The file type in file dialogs.

@shell_words.description: The number of words in the document.

@shell_reopen_closed.description: Opens the tab closed last again.

@shell_next_tab.description: Activates the tab to the right, wrapping around.

@shell_prev_tab.description: Activates the tab to the left, wrapping around.

@shell_go_to_tab.description: Activates the tab at a position, counted from 1.

@shell_strong.description: Makes the selection bold, or removes bold.

@shell_emphasis.description: Makes the selection italic, or removes italic.

@shell_underline.description: Underlines the selection, or removes the underline.

@shell_strike.description: Strikes through the selection, or removes it.

@shell_inline_code.description: Marks the selection as inline code.

@shell_link.description: Turns the selection into a link.

@shell_paragraph.description: Turns the block into a plain paragraph.

@shell_quote.description: Turns the block into a quote, or back.

@shell_bullet_list.description: Turns the block into a bulleted list item.

@shell_ordered_list.description: Turns the block into a numbered list item.

@shell_task_list.description: Turns the block into a task list item.

@shell_toggle_task.description: Checks or unchecks the task at the caret.

@shell_code_block.description: Turns the block into a code block.

@shell_indent.description: Indents the list item or block.

@shell_outdent.description: Outdents the list item or block.

@shell_move_up.description: Moves the block above the previous one.

@shell_move_down.description: Moves the block below the next one.

@shell_row_above.description: Inserts a table row above the caret's.

@shell_row_below.description: Inserts a table row below the caret's.

@shell_col_left.description: Inserts a table column left of the caret's.

@shell_col_right.description: Inserts a table column right of the caret's.

@shell_focus.description: Dims everything but the caret's block.

@shell_typewriter.description: Keeps the caret's line in the middle of the window.

@shell_heading.description: Turns the block into a heading of a level from 1 to 6.
